purpose: Teach: 士郎/一太郎/大竹/せりふ/ぶた/オトコ/メンズ/いっか

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがご友人の士郎さんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he used to exchange letters with your friend Shiro.
lines.style: Soft, thoughtful opening. Gentle nostalgia in the voice. Unhurried pace, as if sifting through old memory. Warm but slightly distant, like looking at an old photograph.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、一太郎ワープロを使われたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and you, Grandpa, back when you were young, you used to write on that Ichitaro word processor, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, playful tease in her voice. Knowing smile underneath. Slightly faster tempo, like she's gently turning the tables on him. Affectionate correction, not criticism.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが大竹さんと将棋を指された
lines.en: Gran, when her father was young, he used to play shogi with Otake.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful continuation. Same wistful register as before. Steady, almost meditative pace. The voice of someone savoring a detail from long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、芝居のせりふを覚えられたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, but you — when you were young, you used to memorize lines from plays, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm affection with a hint of knowing mockery. Leaning in, as if sharing a beloved secret. Slight lift on the playful correction. Tender but firm — she's not letting him off easy.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがぶたの細工物を蒐集された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he collected decorative pig figurines.
lines.style: Same patient, nostalgic tone. Slightly slower here, lingering on the oddness of the detail with quiet humor. Gentle, not mocking. The voice of someone who finds beauty in small, particular things.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ご自身を「いいオトコ」と笑ってらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, but when you were young, you used to laugh and call yourself a 'fine man,' didn't you?
lines.style: Delighted, knowing laugh underneath the words. Quick tempo, almost a sing-song quality to the teasing. She's caught him in vanity and loves him for it. Playful and warm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがメンズスーツをご自身で仕立てられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he even tailored his own men's suits.
lines.style: Continued contemplative tone. Softer attack on this one, as if marveling at a lost skill. Warm appreciation in the voice. Unhurried, like he's saying: 'And that's just the start of what I remember.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、「もういっか、寝よう」って言われた事もあったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, and you — when you were young, there were times you'd just say, 'Ah, forget it. Let's go to bed,' weren't there?
lines.style: Tender, knowing laugh. Softer attack, almost conspiratorial. Slower, warmer pace. She's circling back to the man she knows — tired, human, real. Deep affection in every word.
